tools.description: Read-only, paginated technical audit of articles and both FR/EN versions, without locale fallback. Supports list_posts filters, optional postIds and selected checks: translations, SEO, sources, images, links and structure. Reports missing translations/covers/alt text, unresolved markers, invalid chart data, missing references and links to absent or unpublished CMS articles. No HTTP links are fetched: external availability, factual accuracy, source credibility and editorial quality are NOT verified. SEO length warnings are heuristics. passesAutomatedChecks only means no detected technical errors, never editorial approval. Summaries cover the current page; follow hasNextPage for a complete audit. Does not modify, publish or schedule anything.
tools.name: insight_audit_posts

tools.description: Request cancellation of a Buffer social schedule by returning the existing remote post to draft. Requires exportId and fresh expectedUpdatedAt. Cannot undo an already sent social post. Confirm the draft state through list_posts after the next worker tick.
tools.name: insight_buffer_cancel_schedule

tools.description: Prepare a Buffer social draft linked to an already public, translated CMS article. Choose an actual connected LinkedIn/Facebook channelId and supply platform-adapted text, plus a stable idempotencyKey. Omitting text uses a simple title/excerpt/link template, not AI generation. Uses the public version, never a pending CMS revision. Copies the public cover image and includes a tracked source link in the default template. Delivery wakes the background worker on request, with hourly recovery if notification fails. Creates only a Buffer draft; never publishes or schedules. Read insight_buffer_list_posts to confirm remote status before claiming success.
tools.name: insight_buffer_create_draft

tools.description: List persisted social export requests and confirmed Buffer draft/schedule IDs, target channel, text, errors and timestamps. Status is the last observed Buffer response, not a live social-network delivery guarantee. Supports postId and pagination; get_post also includes recent social distribution records for that article.
tools.name: insight_buffer_list_posts

tools.description: Schedule an existing confirmed Buffer draft for a user-approved explicit date/time. This authorizes future public social publication: call only when requested. Requires the export UUID and fresh expectedUpdatedAt from list_posts. publishAt must have an explicit UTC offset and be at least two minutes ahead. Reuses the remote draft ID, never creates another post. The minute worker checks remote text for unreviewed edits and confirms the Buffer schedule; read list_posts to verify.
tools.name: insight_buffer_schedule_post

tools.description: Check the server-side Buffer connection and list actual organizations/channels. Never returns the API key. First step before choosing a target social channel.
tools.name: insight_buffer_status

tools.description: Revise the text, article link and cover of an existing Buffer draft, reusing its remote ID. Requires a fresh exportId/expectedUpdatedAt, public postId, locale and the complete reviewed social text. Never publishes or schedules. The worker refuses scheduled/sent posts or external text changes. Read list_posts after delivery to verify the final draft.
tools.name: insight_buffer_update_draft

tools.description: Cancel all pending publication jobs for an article without changing its content or publication status. Provide exactly one postId or idempotencyKey. A publication already processing cannot be cancelled.
tools.name: insight_cancel_schedule

tools.description: Create or revise a draft. Body supports ## headings, HTTPS Markdown links, bold and italics. Put [[CHART:name]] and [[IMAGE:name]] markers in separate paragraphs and provide their definitions. relatedPosts selects an ordered list of existing linked article IDs (max 12); [] clears the list, omission preserves it. Use the same idempotencyKey across revisions and translations. Prefer this tool unless publication was explicitly requested.
tools.name: insight_create_draft

tools.description: Read an existing article, including draft content. Provide exactly one identifier: postId for any CMS article, or idempotencyKey for an automation article.
tools.name: insight_get_post

tools.description: List author IDs and public names. No credentials or email addresses are returned.
tools.name: insight_list_authors

tools.description: List available editorial category IDs and names.
tools.name: insight_list_categories

tools.description: List article summaries with exact filtered totals and pagination. Filter by latest saved status, locale, categoryId, heroImage (missing/present), title search or publication date range. No locale fallback: translationPresent reports whether that locale has a title and body. status is the latest saved version; isPublic separately reports whether a published version is live. Use totalDocs to count matches (for example missing covers); request following pages while hasNextPage. Does not return full bodies or edit content.
tools.name: insight_list_posts

tools.description: List pending, processing and failed article publication jobs, including schedules made in the CMS. Dates are UTC; convert to the requested local time zone for display. Cancelled and completed jobs are excluded. Paginate with page and limit.
tools.name: insight_list_schedules

tools.description: Publish an article immediately, making it public. Call only when the user explicitly asks to publish. Send the complete article and the same idempotencyKey used for its draft. relatedPosts selects existing linked article IDs in display order (max 12); omission preserves the selection, [] clears it. Publishing status is shared across FR/EN; create both translations as drafts before publishing.
tools.name: insight_publish

tools.description: Schedule an existing draft for future publication, or replace its pending publication date. Provide exactly one postId or idempotencyKey, publishAt as ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset, and the IANA timeZone (default Africa/Douala). Ask for a date if none was specified. Does not publish immediately or change content. Publishes the latest saved draft and the shared FR/EN publication status. Cloudflare wakes the worker at the requested deadline, with hourly recovery if notification fails; execution may be delayed. An already published article is rejected. Use expectedUpdatedAt to reject stale edits.
tools.name: insight_schedule_post

tools.description: Replace the complete body of any existing article by postId, preserving its slug, publication status, pending schedule and omitted fields. Read get_post first and send its expectedUpdatedAt; a stale edit is rejected. Published content changes become public immediately. Body uses Markdown plus separate CHART/IMAGE markers with definitions. To keep an existing embedded block, put [[BLOCK:name]] in a separate paragraph and pass retainedBlocks with its fields.id from get_post. Removing or rebuilding any old embedded block requires allowBlockRemoval:true; set that only when the user requested the block change. Optional fields can update title, excerpt, SEO, heroImage (null clears it), sources, relatedPosts, authors/categories, FAQ and keyTakeaways. Raw rich-text JSON is not accepted. Only the requested locale is rewritten; shared fields such as heroImage and categories affect both languages.
tools.name: insight_update_content

tools.description: Update selected title, excerpt, SEO description, category IDs, relatedPosts or explicit publication status on an existing article. Provide exactly one of postId or idempotencyKey. Categories replaces the category list; its first item is primary. relatedPosts replaces the ordered list of linked article IDs (max 12); [] clears it. Omitted fields and status are preserved. Related IDs must exist and cannot include the article itself. Never creates an article. Send expectedUpdatedAt from a recent get_post response to reject a stale edit. Set status only when the user requests a publication status change or restoration.
tools.name: insight_update_post

tools.description: Upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (max 3 MiB) from base64 with meaningful alt text. Reuse the returned media ID in heroImage or image markers.
tools.name: insight_upload_media

tools.description: Create or update a traceable research source by HTTPS URL. Returns its ID for the article sources array.
tools.name: insight_upsert_source
